audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty prose is right (EVEN, 51.99% over 8652 games) but the level chart's full layer read a blanket 'Skill' on all seven rows while the content layer and the packet both read Ahri/Skill/Skill/Skill/Zed/Zed/Ahri.
audit.why: Ahri owns levels 1-2 on a 970-range Orb of Deception plus Essence Theft sustain; Zed owns 6 and first item on Death Mark before Zhonya's exists; Ahri owns 2+ items on Zhonya's plus three Spirit Rush charges.
audit.corrected: phases[0].side=Ahri, phases[4].side=Zed, phases[5].side=Zed, phases[6].side=Ahri, matching win[0/4/5/6] already on disk.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes named the spikes without naming what gates them.
audit.why: Level 3 gives W-E-Q; level 6 gives Death Mark, but the window is gated on Charm's 12s downtime; first item is lethal only before Zhonya's.
audit.corrected: Spikes now keyed to a used Charm and to the pre-Zhonya's window.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated: Charm instantly stops movement abilities, which means it cancels Living Shadow's swap dash and Death Mark's dash mid-flight. Charm's cooldown was also written as 'fifteen-second' when it is 12s flat at every rank. Orb of Deception's return hit is true damage, so MR is not an answer.
audit.why: Riot's Charm text: 'instantly stopping movement abilities'. Riot's Q text: 'true damage on the way back'. Kit cooldowns: Charm 12, Fox-Fire 9/8/7/6/5, Spirit Rush 140/120/100, Living Shadow 20/19/18/17/16, Shadow Slash 5/4.5/4/3.5/3, Zed Q 6.
audit.corrected: Charm interaction stated in dontsFull[1].d; real cooldowns put into breakdown.cooldowns; true damage stated in breakdown.early; Essence Theft anti-heal stated in breakdown.mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: It is the field that holds real numbers.
audit.corrected: Charm 12s flat, Fox-Fire 9s to 5s, Living Shadow 20s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: 18 lint findings: 13 misgendered fields calling Ahri he/his/him, 3 copy-paste bleeds, 1 cooldown field with no number.
audit.why: Ahri is female per champ-gender.js; three bullet bodies were the tradeGood/tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.corrected: All pronouns fixed; dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[0].d and dontsFull[2].d rewritten to match their own titles.
